name: nesma-platform
description: AI-powered team communication & task management platform (API + web + mobile)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix mobile install && node server/scripts/init-env.mjs && npm --prefix server run db:deploy && npm --prefix server run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run build && cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run build
